title: MotionByDk AE Workflow Pro v3.9.0 Suite Released!
message: Major update with 1-Click Pop-Out Independent Floating Panels, Liquid Glass branded under MotionByDk, and streamlined Pro UI.
changelog: Native Liquid Glass plugin fully rebranded under MotionByDk (Effects & Presets > MotionByDk > Liquid Glass)
1-Click Pop-Out Independent AE Panels for Bezier Speed Graph, 3D Carousel, Shapes, and Mouse Dock
Streamlined Pro UI: removed redundant Quick Search, Color Swatches, and Kinetic Typography for maximum screen real estate
Universal macOS Apple Silicon (arm64) & Intel (x86_64) native Liquid Glass plugin binary support
Universal Windows 64-bit native LiquidGlass.aex plugin support with 1-click in-panel auto-installer
Real-time Cloudflare D1 Dynamic Activation Engine with 2-PC hardware locking and instant Admin sync
